panel.introduction: Phoebe is a dark, cratered moon on a distant, retrograde orbit around Saturn. Cassini’s 2004 flyby revealed an irregular, ice-bearing surface. It may be a captured object from the outer solar system.

controls.label: Relative albedo
controls.description: Relative brightness from the 2023 Cassini shape/albedo model, normalized near one; not natural color or measured geometric albedo. Cells with fewer than five images or no maplet are marked missing. The 3,500-face display approximates the source shape; map detail is finer than the displayed geometry.

controls.description: Finest contributing SPC maplet spacing in each 1° cell, in m/vertex. Smaller values mean finer local input, not guaranteed height accuracy. Cells without a maplet are marked missing.
